import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/data/nls_bmi_processed.csv')
df.head()

from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
import numpy as np

# Prepare the data for regression
X = df[['DISSAVED', 'SAMESAVE']].values  # Predictor variables (time preference factors)
y = df['BMI'].values  # Response variable (BMI)

# Create a linear regression model
model = LinearRegression()
model.fit(X, y)

# Get the coefficients and p-values
coefficients = model.coef_
p_values = np.zeros(2)  # Placeholder for p-values, as they are not directly available from LinearRegression

# Print the coefficients
coefficients

import statsmodels.api as sm

# Add a constant to the predictor variables
X = sm.add_constant(df[['DISSAVED', 'SAMESAVE']])

# Create a linear regression model
model = sm.OLS(y, X).fit()

# Print the summary of the model
model.summary()
